representation_source: dialogue_attractor.content_tokens plus adjacent meaningful rooted token pairs
rationale: The v5 exact-node refractory test found zero consecutive top-K node-ID overlap on both frozen evidence blocks despite visibly recurring semantic themes. This test moves inhibition one level up, to the same generic rooted meaningful word-pairs already used by the repository's recurring-content attractor guard. No topic rules, embeddings, LLM judging, or newly tuned similarity threshold are introduced.
interpretation: Semantic refractory selection advances only if it reduces consecutive selected meaningful-pair overlap by at least 0.10 absolute while retaining at least 90% of immediate retrieval utility and discounted four-tick future retrieval-rank utility on BOTH frozen evidence blocks. A zero-penalty ablation must exactly reproduce ordinary retrieval. Passing permits only a prospective replication stage using retrieval-time evidence; it does not permit shadow or live influence.
